text.en:
The present Bureau of Special Services of the Department of Tourism shall henceforth be known as
the Bureau of Tourism Services and for this purpose, Presidential Decree No. 189 is accordingly amended.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of November in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
